function.name: update_context
function.description: Apply only explicit user changes. Omitted fields retain their values. Arrays replace existing arrays. Set match_mode to all only when the user chooses an exact match, or some when the user allows partial matches.

function.name: inspect_catalog
function.description: Look up recipe titles and ingredient names from SQLite.

function.name: search_recipes
function.description: Find and validate recipes using the remembered context after the user has chosen exact or partial matching.

function.name: get_recipe_details
function.description: Read SQLite recipe facts for a recipe in the current results, explicit selections, or current weekly plan. Use this to inspect source cooking steps before building a prep timeline.

function.name: read_pdf_page
function.description: Read original PDF text using a known source page ID.

function.name: respond
function.description: Finish with a concise answer or clarification question.

function.name: recall_conversation
function.description: Read exact earlier messages from this conversation. Use before guessing an old preference, decision or reference. Empty query lists all history; paginate using next_offset. User messages are choices, not evidence of recipe facts.

function.name: query_recipe_results
function.description: Filter, sort, limit and count verified recipes in any supported combination, and update displayed cards. Text inclusion and exclusion check both recipe titles and source ingredient lists. match_percent is the percentage displayed on cards: recipe ingredient names available. pantry_match_percent is the share of the user's pantry names used. Uses remembered pantry/diet/exclusions, so do not duplicate dietary context as a result filter. Omitted options persist. Result count is displayed cards; total_count is all matches before limit. Over is gt, at least is gte; lowest first is asc. Unknown nutrition never qualifies for numerical comparisons.

filters.description: All conditions must hold. Replaces previous conditions: retain earlier ones unless user changes them. Empty list clears conditions.

limit.description: How many cards to show; null removes the limit.

include_ingredients.description: Show only recipes where every requested term appears in either the recipe title or source ingredient list. Use for requests such as only chicken recipes. Empty list clears this restriction.

exclude_ingredients.description: Hide recipes where any requested term appears in either the recipe title or source ingredient list. The LLM should include relevant members when the user names a broad category. Empty list clears this restriction.

exclude_recipe_ids.description: Hide specific returned recipe IDs selected by the LLM after semantic review of titles and ingredients. Preserve earlier IDs unless the user changes the filter. Empty list clears this restriction.

title_contains.description: Show only recipes whose title contains this term. Use only when the user explicitly asks to filter titles. Empty string clears this restriction.

function.name: set_weekly_plan
function.description: Create or replace the current draft plan using only recipe IDs explicitly selected by the user in the interface.

function.name: set_prep_timeline
function.description: Create or replace a preparation timeline for the current plan. Every task must cite real step numbers from plan recipes.

function.name: save_weekly_plan
function.description: Save the current plan only after the user explicitly asks to save or finalize it.

function.name: search_usda_foods
function.description: Search the imported official USDA food records for a food-level nutrition lookup.

function.name: get_usda_food_nutrition
function.description: Read one retrieved USDA food record for a specified gram weight; do not treat it as a verified recipe mapping.
